risk_if_not_implemented: Without Acceptable Discoverable Information, known and exploitable vulnerabilities may remain unaddressed, giving adversaries readily available entry points. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Loss of Confidentiality (R-IP-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Continuous Monitoring
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of enterprise-wide monitoring controls.
compensating_control_1.justification: Continuous Monitoring (MON-02) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Acceptable Discoverable Information (VPM-16) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Vulnerability Scanning
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to detect vulnerabilities and configuration errors by routine vulnerability scanning of systems and applications.
compensating_control_2.justification: Vulnerability Scanning (VPM-12) provides vulnerability management that compensates for the absence of Acceptable Discoverable Information (VPM-16) by reducing the exploitable attack surface by addressing known weaknesses before they are leveraged. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
